title: Generation Z
description:
S01 E02
Charlie and Kelly deal with Kelly's nan, as Kelly battles with her conflicting feelings; Steff heads off on a dangerous quest with Finn; Cecily incites the hungry OAP horde, while Frank gets lost, and Jason is attacked.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E03 — Get Out and Push
All hope seems lost when the crew learns an asteroid is hours away from impact.

title: The Ark
description:
S01 E04 — We Weren't Supposed to Be Awake
When their psyches are put to the test by hallucinations, the crew must race to find the cause.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E11 — And the Graffiti of the Gods
Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E12 — And the Unfinished Business
General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E05 — The Grand Complication Job
When Sophie is abducted, rivals Parker and Astrid are forced into a desperate race against time to save her by securing the elusive Marie Antoinette watch; unaware of each other's involvement, they embark on a high stakes quest to save Sophie.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E06 — The Swipe Right Job
Sophie's return to dating goes awry when her newest flame is a billionaire, swindling men and women to fund his lavish lifestyle; to dismantle his million dollar scheme, the team must create the perfect romantic specimen and bait the catfish.

title: The Librarian: Curse of the Judas Chalice
description: Unlikely adventurer Flynn Carsen sets out to protect a precious chalice from vampire Prince Vlad Dracul.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E01 — And the Rise of Chaos
The Egyptian God of Chaos inhabits a human, and tries to release pure evil into the world; the librarians must decipher clues in a science museum.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E02 — And the Fangs of Death
Flynn leads the others on a rescue mission, which leads them into a subterranean trap filled with ancient Egyptian werewolves.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E03 — And the Reunion of Evil
A routine artifact retrieval becomes complicated when the artifact grafts itself to Cassandra; a blizzard forces Stone and Cassandra to take shelter at a mysterious hotel.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E04 — And the Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
After seeing a vision of her own death at the hands of a supernatural assassin, Baird attempts to stop the deadly prophecy from coming true.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E05 — And the Tears of a Clown
The librarians investigate a traveling carnival where they discover the sinister secret of a magician who has been corrupted by the use of real magic.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E06 — And the Trial of the Triangle
In order to stop the spread of pure evil, the team must find the Eye of Ra and unravel the mystery of the Bermuda Triangle; Flynn must pass a series of tests.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E07 — And the Curse of Cindy
Cindy Kroger suddenly becomes popular thanks to a magical love potion; the librarians must stop Cindy before she launches a love missile that would force the entire world to become her fan base.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E08 — And the Eternal Question
The librarians are led to a holistic spa that is run by vampires when a rash of people spontaneously combust.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E09 — And the Fatal Separation
The balance of the universe is put in jeopardy when the Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over by a ruthless collector of magical artifacts.

title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E10 — And the Wrath of Chaos
The library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep; Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins must put aside their differences to save the library, the world and themselves.

description:
S01 E01 — The Nigerian Job
After recovering stolen airplane designs, Nate's team must figure out how to return them to the rightful owner.

description:
S01 E02 — The Homecoming Job
In order to help a wounded reservist, the team tries to expose the truth about a security firm.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E07 — The Wedding Job
The team poses as wedding planners to get close to a Mafia boss and must pull off a wedding while pulling off the heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E09 — The Snow Job
The team goes after a construction company that foreclosed on a National Guardsman's home; Nate puts the team in jeopardy with his drinking.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E08 — The Mile High Job
All the evidence the team seeks to expose a cover-up is on a plane heading to the Cayman Islands; airborne, the team uncovers a more sinister situation.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E03 — The Two Horse Job
The team travels to Kentucky to help a horse trainer who lost everything when the racehorses he trains were killed in a fire.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E05 — The Bank Shot Job
Nate, Sophie and the mark are taken hostage during a bank robbery; the team tries to help the two amateur and desperate robbers.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E04 — The Miracle Job
Nate helps his old friend Father Paul stop the demolition of his church. His means however, a fake miracle, are a lot less holy than his ends.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E06 — The Stork Job
The team goes after an adoption company that is scamming couples looking to adopt war orphans; the team hijacks the production of a horror movie.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E11 — The Juror No. 6 Job
One of Parker's aliases is chosen for jury duty; the team tries to stop someone from buying a favorable verdict in the trial.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E10 — The 12 Step Job
The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E12 — The First David Job
The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

title: Leverage
description:

Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E02 — The Tap-Out Job
The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E03 — The Order 23 Job
The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.
